name: failed-resume-forgets-the-stale-id
description: After a failed resume and a failed fresh retry, the next prompt starts a fresh session instead of resuming the stale id again.
reason: The retry clears the stale id so it is never resumed again. Each folder also keeps its own saved id (v1.6 multi-project); if that copy survived, every later start would resume the stale id, fail, and (the one retry being spent) report an error until the person pressed New Session.
source: DESIGN.md core rule 'retry ONCE without resumeSessionID (covers stale session ids)' and v1.6 addendum B (per-folder session ids); AppState.handleTermination

script.reason: App launch resumes the saved conversation.
The resume fails before init; PowerUp retries fresh.
The fresh retry fails as well (for example, a network blip).
The person tries again; the session is started on demand.

transcript.text: Couldn't resume the previous session — starting a fresh one.
